app.name: EON Download Manager
about: EON Download Manager {version}. Free and open source, for everyone, with no account and no telemetry.
add.label: Link to download
add.placeholder: Paste a link and press Enter
batch.title: A numbered series
batch.help: Write the part that changes as a range in brackets: photo[001-120].jpg, part[a-f].zip.
batch.label: Address with a range
batch.single: No range in brackets: just one file
rail.label: Downloads
list.label: Downloads
empty.title: Nothing downloading yet
empty.body: Paste a link above, or press Ctrl+V anywhere in this window.
deck.label: Details
deck.lanes.live: {n} connections working, the file in {segments} parts
fact.no: No — the server doesn't allow it
verify.label: Compare with a published SHA-256
verify.match: It matches: this is the file that was published.
verify.mismatch: It doesn't match. Don't open this file.
sheet.title: Download
sheet.name: File name
sheet.asking: Asking the server about this file…
sheet.error.title: That link didn't lead to a file
sheet.not.resumable: Can't resume: the server doesn't allow it
links.title: {n} links
refresh.title: Give it a new link
refresh.help: Links from many sites expire. Get a fresh one from the same page; everything already downloaded is kept if the file is the same.
refresh.label: New link
refresh.done: The new link works; downloading continues
remove.title: Remove “{name}” from the list?
settings.title: Settings
settings.sort: A folder for each kind of file (Video, Music, Programs…)
settings.ignore: Resume even if the server says the file changed
settings.browsers.help: Connect once, then add the EON extension to the browser. Downloads you start there come here.
settings.clipboard: Offer to download links I copy
settings.tray: Keep downloading in the tray when I close the window
settings.notify: Tell me when a download finishes or fails
browser.done: Browsers connected. Now add the EON extension to them.
scheduler.title: Scheduler
scheduler.help: Run the waiting downloads at night, when the line is free.
clipboard.title: Download this?
error.title: That didn't work
error.refused: The server refused. The link may have expired.
error.gone: The file isn't on the server any more.
error.http: The server answered with an error.
error.busy: The server is busy or allows fewer connections.
error.disk: The file couldn't be written. Is the disk full?
error.changed: The file changed on the server.
error.invalid: That isn't something that can be downloaded.
error.unsupported: This kind of stream can't be downloaded.
error.not_found: That download isn't in the list any more.
error.hint.refresh: Get a fresh link from the page and give it a new link.
tray.hint.title: Still downloading
tray.hint.body: EON Download Manager keeps going in the tray. Quit it from there.
connect.title: Catch downloads from your browser
connect.lead: Click a download in your browser and it comes here, faster and resumable. Two steps, once.
connect.host.title: Your browsers know EON Download Manager
connect.host.no: Not yet. This happens by itself when the program starts.
connect.ext.title: Add the EON extension
connect.ext.help: Its extensions page and a folder open. Turn on Developer mode, choose Load unpacked, and pick that folder.
connect.firefox: Firefox needs Mozilla's signature on the extension; it comes with the store listing.
connect.seen.title: Connected
connect.seen.yes: The extension in {browser} is talking to this program. Click any download and it comes here.
connect.seen.wait: Waiting for the extension to say hello…
connect.opened: {browser}'s extensions page and the folder are open
